name: Beating Together
source:
Beating together tells us a story about Eliot and how you should interact with him, your decisions affect the course of the story and may end well or end badly, it all depends on what you choose.

[From [url=https://feranimaciones.itch.io/beating-together-graphic-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
